name: caption/S6.4 · deploy-progress-pipeline
text: S6.4 redraws the Publish progress panel, so it owes the Publish correction. Carried 2026-09-07 from the worker itself: STEPS is FIVE — Generating pages · Optimizing images · Deploying to CDN · Verifying SSL · Performance check (workers/publish/[jobId]/route.ts:22-28) — and two of them report skipped, never done (SKIPPED_STEPS, :34-37), so the green tick this board drew on image optimisation was a false signal and is now a dash. Generate CSS and DNS propagation are not steps the worker emits and are marked [not-implemented] rather than deleted. CANCEL: the last checkCancelled runs BEFORE runVercelDeploy (:374-375) and there is none inside it, so a cancel during the deploy does not stop the deploy. The sanctioned wording, which this board must not contradict, is: If the deploy had already started it may still finish. We will tell you which. Canonical for the cancelled state: note/Publish 2876:12480 and section 15 · Publish.
